segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: I came to Riverside three years ago and I could barely walk up a flight of stairs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Dr. Okafor sat with me for a full hour on that first visit. Nobody had ever done that.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: My daughter was 18 months old and running a fever that would not come down.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: They saw us at eleven at night. No appointment, no questions asked.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: I have been coming here for 40 years, since before Marion took over the front desk.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: This place turned my life around, and I do not say that lightly.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_03
segments.text: What gets me is that they remember your name. Every single time you walk in.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_04
segments.text: To everyone at Riverside, thank you for looking after my family. It means the world.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_04
segments.text: Take care of yourselves, and we will see you at the summer fair. Goodbye.
